title: mDNS Discovery
intro: Advertises this server on the local network, under this computer's name, so clients (e.g. the Android app) can find it without typing an IP. Changes take effect on next restart.
savedRestart: Saved — astrolol needs to be restarted for this to take effect.
autofillHint: Fill the port and scheme below from the address used to load this page.
portHint: Leave blank for astrolol's own port (8000). Set it when a web server such as nginx exposes astrolol on another one (443 for HTTPS).

manifest.name: mDNS Discovery
manifest.description: Advertises this astrolol server on the local network via mDNS.
